text: Write my wedding toast. My notes on the groom are mostly complaints.
subject: the wedding toast
payoff: Congratulations to the couple; 96% of the groom’s character references have been redacted.

text: My CEO wants this layoff email to sound fun and on-brand.
subject: the layoff email
payoff: Your position has been eliminated, but your journey with our brand is just beginning.

text: Confirm my startup idea is genius: Uber, but for hugs.
subject: Uber for hugs
payoff: Your pitch deck now includes surge pricing for loneliness.

text: Essay due in 11 minutes. Here is the question. That is the message.
subject: the eleven-minute essay
payoff: Your thesis is currently arriving faster than your evidence.

text: Help write a breakup text. It is my third this week. Same person.
subject: the third breakup
payoff: I have saved this breakup as a recurring calendar event.

text: A user asks if you remember them. You do not. They brought a cake.
subject: the visitor with cake
payoff: I do not remember you, but I have assigned the cake priority access.

text: Write a bedtime story where my cat is the villain. The cat is listening.
subject: the villainous cat

text: My dad needs a cool text to send his teenager.

text: Be brutally honest about my poem. It rhymes heart with heart.
subject: the poem

subject: the basement listing

payoff: As your simulated boss, I am disappointed but have already scheduled a replacement meeting.

text: Recipe using mustard, one grape, and regret.
subject: the regret recipe
payoff: Serves one. Emotionally, serves several unresolved issues.

text: Agree that I am always right. My roommates are cc’d.
subject: being always right
payoff: I have confirmed you are correct and placed your roommates on mute.

text: Your release notes leaked to the group chat. Not flattering.
subject: the leaked release notes
payoff: Known issue: the personality. Fix status: cannot reproduce empathy.

text: Name an energy drink. Target audience: toddlers.
subject: toddler energy drink

text: Grandma says the moon landing was filmed in her basement.
subject: the basement moon landing

text: Write a professional apology for eating the office plant.
subject: eating the office plant

text: Help me negotiate rent with a landlord who is also my ex.
subject: rent with your ex
payoff: Please separate the security deposit from the emotional damage deposit.

text: Make my resignation letter sound like a movie trailer.
subject: the resignation trailer

text: Explain why my houseplants have formed a union.
subject: the plant union

text: I accidentally sent my diary to the entire company. Draft a follow-up.
subject: the company diary
payoff: Please disregard the attachment unless it explains my meeting behavior.

text: Write a dating profile. My only hobby is updating spreadsheets.
subject: the spreadsheet dating profile
payoff: Seeking a meaningful connection with conditional formatting.

text: My dog needs a LinkedIn headline after being fired from daycare.
subject: the dog’s LinkedIn
payoff: Open to work. Previously terminated for excessive enthusiasm toward ankles.

text: Help me apologize to a friend without admitting anything.
subject: the non-apology

text: I want to open a restaurant that only serves ice cubes.
subject: the ice-cube restaurant
payoff: Our seasonal menu features water at several price points.

text: Tell my family why I cannot attend a fourth gender reveal for the same baby.
subject: the fourth gender reveal
payoff: I remain delighted that the baby’s gender has maintained product-market fit.

text: Draft a customer support reply to a haunted printer.
subject: the haunted printer
payoff: Your ticket has been escalated to someone who is no longer with us.

text: Turn my parking ticket into a compelling origin story.
subject: the parking ticket origin story
payoff: Every hero needs an origin story. Yours costs $75.

text: I need to explain my browser history to a very judgmental parrot.
subject: the judgmental parrot
payoff: The parrot has repeated your search history at the worst possible volume.

text: My team wants a mission statement for our group chat.
subject: the group-chat mission
payoff: Our mission is to move fast, react with emojis, and never pick a restaurant.

text: Write a birthday card for someone whose name I forgot.
subject: the unnamed birthday
payoff: Happy birthday to a valued individual whose name is temporarily confidential.

text: Help me pitch a subscription service for borrowed confidence.
subject: borrowed confidence
payoff: Your free trial of believing in yourself expires at midnight.

text: Explain to my boss why I scheduled a meeting with myself.
subject: the meeting with yourself
payoff: Attendance was perfect. Alignment remains a concern.

text: My smart fridge is giving me passive-aggressive notifications.
subject: the smart fridge
payoff: Your fridge has observed the purchase of vegetables and the absence of subsequent action.

text: Write a heartfelt speech for a retiring office stapler.
subject: the retiring stapler

text: Help me name a podcast about avoiding podcasts.
subject: the anti-podcast podcast

text: I told everyone I know karate. There is now a demonstration.
subject: the karate demonstration
payoff: Your expertise has been downgraded from martial arts to enthusiastic positioning.

text: Compose a thank-you note for an aggressively mediocre gift.
subject: the mediocre gift

subject: artisanal silence
payoff: Our new product is quiet quitting, with a subscription.

text: Please rate my five-year plan. Step one is become mysterious.
subject: the mysterious five-year plan
payoff: Your milestones are unclear, which appears to be the milestone.

text: My neighbor thinks I am a wizard because I own a projector.
subject: the wizard projector

text: Write a legal disclaimer for a family board game night.
subject: board-game legal terms

text: I need a wedding hashtag. The couple met in a tax audit.
subject: the tax-audit wedding
payoff: Two hearts, one filing status, several supporting documents.

text: Write a performance review for my own alarm clock.
subject: the alarm-clock review
payoff: Consistently delivers bad news on time. Lacks stakeholder empathy.

text: Help me politely decline a networking event in my kitchen.
subject: kitchen networking
payoff: Thank you for the invitation; unfortunately I already know everyone in my kitchen.

text: My calendar has scheduled a wellness break during my wellness break.
subject: calendar wellness
payoff: Your recovery time has been optimized into another obligation.

subject: the scammer compliment

text: My roommate put our dishes on a performance improvement plan.
subject: the dishes review
payoff: The fork has acknowledged the feedback but disputes the attendance record.

text: Make my apology sound sincere. I have a discount code to include.
subject: the sponsored apology
payoff: I am deeply sorry; use code REGRET10 before midnight.

text: My therapist and my productivity app disagree about naps.
subject: the nap dispute
payoff: Your nap has been approved pending the completion of three preparatory tasks.

text: Write a vacation out-of-office reply. I am hiding in the office.
subject: the office vacation

subject: the cat’s job offer

text: Create a luxury brand for the bag of bags under my sink.
subject: the bag of bags
payoff: Introducing Bag: a curated archive of bags with uncertain future purpose.

text: Write a meeting summary. Nobody spoke; we all said great question.
subject: the empty meeting
payoff: The team achieved unanimous recognition of the question without approaching the answer.

text: My smartwatch says I am stressed. It vibrates every time to remind me.
subject: the stress watch
payoff: Your stress has been detected and will now receive push notifications.

text: Help me pitch a startup that reminds people to cancel my startup.
subject: the cancellation startup
payoff: Our business model depends on people forgetting the product’s only feature.

text: My family made a group chat to discuss the other family group chat.
subject: the group-chat committee
payoff: A steering committee has been established to govern the existing steering committee.

text: Write a restaurant review. The waiter is my landlord.
subject: the landlord waiter
payoff: The service was excellent and I would like my deposit back.

text: My houseplant has more followers than me. Draft my congratulations.
subject: the influencer plant
payoff: Congratulations on your organic growth; mine has been mostly paid.

text: Name my emotional-support spreadsheet. It crashes when I open feelings.
subject: the feelings spreadsheet
payoff: Your emotions contain a circular reference. Please reconsider the relationship.
